description: This file defines the Request class, which handles HTTP request data in the OpenCart framework. It manages GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER variables, providing methods to access and sanitize input data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class to encapsulate HTTP request data, including sanitization and type-specific retrieval methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes request data properties by cleaning global variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sanitized GET parameter, cast to a specified type.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Retrieves a sanitized POST parameter, cast to a specified type.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Recursively sanitizes input data by trimming and escaping HTML characters.
